review_notes: Corrected on the same ground as 2.10 and 2.18: in דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן צָפֹנָה the definite construct phrase is the subject and צָפֹנָה the predicate, so the construction's copula goes to the predicate under rule 20 and sits on the locative marker under rule 49.

The ASV's On the north side shall be the standard is subject-verb inversion with no dummy subject, which confirms that the standard-phrase is the subject rather than a predicate nominal with a fronted adjunct (rule 49's closing paragraph).
